1.english_reference: The word of the LORD came again unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et factus est sermo Dómini ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: The word of the LORD came again unto me , saying ,

2.english_reference: Son of man , set thy face against the Ammonites ,

traditions.WLC: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖י ךָ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן

traditions.VUL: Fili hóminis , pone fáciem tuam contra fílios Ammon ,
traditions.KJV: Son of man , set thy face against the Ammonites ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הִנָּבֵ֖א עֲלֵי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ προφήτευσον ἐπ᾽ αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: et prophetábis de eis .
traditions.KJV: and prophesy against them ;

3.english_reference: And say unto the Ammonites , Hear the word of the Lord GOD ;

traditions.WLC: וְ אָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לִ בְנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρεῖς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἀμμών Ἀκούσατε λόγον Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: Et dices fíliis Ammon : Audíte verbum Dómini Dei :
traditions.KJV: And say unto the Ammonites , Hear the word of the Lord GOD ;

traditions.WLC: כֹּה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֡ה
traditions.LXX: Τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the Lord GOD ;

3.english_reference: Because thou saidst , Aha , against my sanctuary , when it was profaned ;

traditions.WLC: יַעַן֩ אָמְרֵ֨ ךְ הֶאָ֜ח אֶל מִקְדָּשִׁ֣ י כִֽי נִחָ֗ל
traditions.LXX: Ἀνθ᾽ ὧν ἐπεχάρητε ἐπὶ τὰ ἅγιά μου ὅτι ἐβεβηλώθη ,
traditions.VUL: Pro eo quod dixísti : Euge , euge super sanctuárium meum , quia pollútum est :
traditions.KJV: Because thou saidst , Aha , against my sanctuary , when it was profaned ;

3.english_reference: and against the land of Israel , when it was desolate ;

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶל אַדְמַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כִּ֣י נָשַׁ֔מָּה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ ὅτι ἠφανίσθη ,
traditions.VUL: et super terram Israel , quóniam desoláta est :
traditions.KJV: and against the land of Israel , when it was desolate ;

3.english_reference: and against the house of Judah , when they went into captivity ;

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶל בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה כִּ֥י הָלְכ֖וּ בַּ גּוֹלָֽה

traditions.VUL: et super domum Iuda , quóniam ducti sunt in captivitátem :
traditions.KJV: and against the house of Judah , when they went into captivity ;

4.english_reference: Behold , therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession ,

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֡ן הִנְ נִי֩ נֹתְנָ֨ ךְ לִ בְנֵי קֶ֜דֶם לְ מֽוֹרָשָׁ֗ה
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ παραδίδωμι ὑμᾶς τοῖς υἱοῖς Κέδεμ εἰς κληρονομίαν ,

traditions.KJV: Behold , therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession ,

4.english_reference: and they shall set their palaces in thee , and make their dwellings in thee :

traditions.WLC: וְ יִשְּׁב֤וּ טִירֽוֹתֵי הֶם֙ בָּ֔ ךְ וְ נָ֥תְנוּ בָ֖ ךְ מִשְׁכְּנֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατασκηνώσουσιν ἐν τῇ ἀπαρτείᾳ αὐτῶν ἐν σοί , καί δώσουσιν ἐν σοὶ τὰ σκηνώματα αὐτῶν ·
traditions.VUL: et collocábunt caulas suas in te , et ponent in te tentória sua :
traditions.KJV: and they shall set their palaces in thee , and make their dwellings in thee :

4.english_reference: they shall eat thy fruit , and they shall drink thy milk .

traditions.WLC: הֵ֚מָּה יֹאכְל֣וּ פִרְיֵ֔ ךְ וְ הֵ֖מָּה יִשְׁתּ֥וּ חֲלָבֵֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: αὐτοὶ φάγονται τοὺς καρπούς σου , καὶ αὐτοὶ πίονται τὴν πιότητά σου .

traditions.KJV: they shall eat thy fruit , and they shall drink thy milk .

5.english_reference: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels ,

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתַתִּ֤י אֶת רַבָּה֙ לִ נְוֵ֣ה גְמַלִּ֔ים

traditions.VUL: Dabóque Rabbath in habitáculum camelórum ,
traditions.KJV: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels ,

5.english_reference: and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks :

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן לְ מִרְבַּץ צֹ֑אן
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἀμμὼν εἰς νομὴν προβάτων ·
traditions.VUL: et fílios Ammon in cubíle pécorum :
traditions.KJV: and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks :

5.english_reference: and ye shall know that I [ am ] the LORD .

traditions.WLC: וִֽ ידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε διότι ἐγὼ Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: et sciétis quia ego Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: and ye shall know that I [ am ] the LORD .

6.english_reference: For thus saith the Lord GOD ;

traditions.LXX: διότι τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Quia hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: For thus saith the Lord GOD ;

traditions.VUL: Pro eo quod plausísti manu et percussísti pede ,
traditions.KJV: Because thou hast clapped [ thine ] hands , and stamped with the feet ,

6.english_reference: and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel ;

traditions.WLC: וַ תִּשְׂמַ֤ח בְּ כָל שָֽׁאטְ ךָ֙ בְּ נֶ֔פֶשׁ אֶל אַדְמַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπέχαρας ἐκ ψυχῆς σου ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: et gavísa es ex toto afféctu super terram Israel :
traditions.KJV: and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel ;

7.english_reference: Behold , therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee ,

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֡ן הִנְ נִי֩ נָטִ֨יתִי אֶת יָדִ֜ י עָלֶ֗י ךָ

traditions.KJV: Behold , therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ δώσω σε εἰς διαρπαγὴν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ,
traditions.VUL: et tradam te in direptiónem géntium ,
traditions.KJV: and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen ;

7.english_reference: and I will cut thee off from the people ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπολῶ σε ἐκ τῶν χωρῶν ἀπωλείᾳ ·
traditions.VUL: et perdam de terris ,
traditions.KJV: and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries :

traditions.WLC: אַשְׁמִ֣ידְ ךָ֔
traditions.VUL: et cónteram :
traditions.KJV: I will destroy thee ;

traditions.LXX: Τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the Lord GOD ;

traditions.WLC: יַ֗עַן אֲמֹ֤ר מוֹאָב֙ וְ שֵׂעִ֔יר הִנֵּ֥ה כְּ כָֽל הַ גּוֹיִ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: Ἀνθ᾽ ὧν εἶπεν Μωάβ Ἰδοὺ οὐχ ὃν τρόπον πάντα τὰ ἔθνη οἶκος Ἰσραὴλ καὶ Ἰούδα ;
traditions.VUL: Pro eo quod dixérunt Moab et Seir : Ecce sicut omnes gentes , domus Iuda :
traditions.KJV: Because that Moab and Seir do say , Behold , the house of Judah [ is ] like unto all the heathen ;

9.english_reference: Therefore , behold , I will open the side of Moab from the cities , from his cities [ which are ] on his frontiers ,

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵן֩ הִנְ נִ֨י פֹתֵ֜חַ אֶת כֶּ֤תֶף מוֹאָב֙ מֵ הֶ֣ עָרִ֔ים מֵֽ עָרָ֖י ו מִ קָּצֵ֑ הוּ
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ παραλύω τὸν ὦμον Μωάβ ἀπὸ πόλεων ἀκρωτηρίων αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: idcírco ecce ego apériam húmerum Moab de civitátibus , de civitátibus , inquam , eius , et de fínibus eius ,

9.english_reference: the glory of the country , Bethjeshimoth , Baalmeon , and Kiriathaim ,

traditions.WLC: צְבִ֗י אֶ֚רֶץ בֵּ֣ית הַיְשִׁימֹ֔ת בַּ֥עַל מְע֖וֹן ו קריתמ ה

traditions.WLC: לִ בְנֵי קֶ֨דֶם֙ עַל בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּ נְתַתִּ֖י הָ לְ מֽוֹרָשָׁ֑ה

traditions.WLC: לְמַ֛עַן לֹֽא תִזָּכֵ֥ר בְּנֵֽי עַמּ֖וֹן בַּ גּוֹיִֽם

traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :

traditions.KJV: Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance ,

traditions.LXX: ἐμνησικάκησαν καὶ ἐξεδίκησαν δίκην ,

traditions.KJV: and hath greatly offended , and revenged himself upon them ;

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֔ה

traditions.VUL: idcírco hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :

traditions.KJV: Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge ,

15.english_reference: and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart , to destroy [ it ] for the old hatred

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּנָּקְמ֤וּ נָקָם֙ בִּ שְׁאָ֣ט בְּ נֶ֔פֶשׁ לְ מַשְׁחִ֖ית אֵיבַ֥ת עוֹלָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξανέστησαν ἐκδίκησιν , ἐπιχαίροντες ἐκ ψυχῆς τοῦ ἐξαλεῖψαι ἕως ἑνός ,
traditions.VUL: et ulti se sunt toto ánimo , interficiéntes , et impléntes inimicítias véteres :
traditions.KJV: and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart , to destroy [ it ] for the old hatred ;

16.english_reference: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֔ה
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: proptérea hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ;

16.english_reference: Behold , I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֨י נוֹטֶ֤ה יָדִ י֙ עַל פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים
traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐκτενῶ τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους ,
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego exténdam manum meam super Palæstínos ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines ,

16.english_reference: and I will cut off the Cherethims

traditions.WLC: וְ הִכְרַתִּ֖י אֶת כְּרֵתִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσω Κρῆτας ,
traditions.VUL: et interfíciam interfectóres ,
traditions.KJV: and I will cut off the Cherethims ,

16.english_reference: and destroy the remnant of the sea coast

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ֣אֲבַדְתִּ֔י אֶת שְׁאֵרִ֖ית ח֥וֹף הַ יָּֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπολῶ τοὺς καταλοίπους τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν παραλίαν ·
traditions.VUL: et perdam relíquias marítimæ regiónis :
traditions.KJV: and destroy the remnant of the sea coast .

17.english_reference: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes

traditions.WLC: וְ עָשִׂ֤יתִי בָ ם֙ נְקָמ֣וֹת גְּדֹל֔וֹת בְּ תוֹכְח֖וֹת חֵמָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ποιήσω ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐκδικήσεις μεγάλας ,
traditions.VUL: faciámque in eis ultiónes magnas , árguens in furóre :
traditions.KJV: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes ;

17.english_reference: and they shall know that I [ am ] the LORD , when I shall lay my vengeance upon them

traditions.WLC: וְ יָֽדְעוּ֙ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בְּ תִתִּ֥ י אֶת נִקְמָתִ֖ י בָּֽ ם
traditions.LXX: ἐπιγνώσονται διότι ἐγὼ Κύριος , ἐν τῷ δοῦναι τὴν ἐκδίκησίν μου ἐπ᾽ αὐτούς .
traditions.VUL: et scient quia ego Dóminus , cum dédero vindíctam meam super eos .
traditions.KJV: and they shall know that I [ am ] the LORD , when I shall lay my vengeance upon them .
